summary: The v0.4 stations and routes laid out to match the harbor: every Manhattan station is on Manhattan, every New Jersey station is on the New Jersey shore, and each cross-river route visibly crosses the Hudson or the East River.
designGoals: Preserve v0.3 as the stable 13-station baseline while the next wave explores new Manhattan, Queens, and Jersey nodes.
Keep the board graph-first and readable while testing west-Manhattan and outer-ring additions without collapsing into central overlap.
Prefer board-game compression over literal geography, but remove direct links that break real-world transit intuition too sharply.
Use controlled station waves so each addition justifies its strategy and space on the board.
changeSummary: No station, route, length, colour or ticket changed from v0.4; only positions, labels and the basemap.
Moved Hudson Yards, Chelsea, Exchange Place and Grove St out of the water and onto their own shores.
Moved Battery Park to the southern tip of Manhattan; it was drawn on the Brooklyn side.
The Newark Airport to Hudson Yards route curves through New Jersey instead of following the board edge.
Board labels use the full station names, the same as tickets.
Basemap v2: the band painted along the left and top edges is gone.
playtestFocus: Check that the Newark Airport to Hudson Yards route still reads as a long outer route now that it is off the edge.
